name: Steal An Anime Egg
desc:
🥚 Welcome to Steal An Anime Egg!

How to Play:
🥚 Steal eggs from anime characters
🐣 Hatch eggs to collect rare anime units
💰 Earn money from your anime units
⬆️ Upgrade your treadmill and base
🏃 Train on the treadmill to gain Speed
🥷 Steal eggs from other players
✨ Discover rarer eggs, anime units, sizes, and mutations!
